The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 48c3a89da2a380d1), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 3-4. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. The quote crosses a page break and includes whatever the extraction places there, such as a page number. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. statement: The polynomial pQ is homogeneous of degree n(n + 1) and hyperbolic with respect to e = (In, In, 0), with pQ(e) = 1. Fix y and choose vectors b1, . . . , bn ∈ Rr with Q(y) = ∑︁n j=1 bjb⊤ j . Define Bj = (︄ 0 b⊤ j −bj 0 )︄ , B = ⎛ ⎜ ⎝ B1 . . . Bn ⎞ ⎟ ⎠ . 3 Then the closed hyperbolicity cone KQ of pQ is characterized, at this value of y, by (X, Z, y) ∈ KQ ⇐⇒ (︄ In ⊗ X B B⊤ Z )︄ ⪰ 0. (2.3)
